selection_protocol.gold_selection_rule: All gold candidates listed in clean_task1_train_labels_2026.json for the 20 discovery queries (excluding self if any). Unrestricted by BM25 top-k.
selection_protocol.non_gold_selection_rule: Top 3 candidates per query by fixed BM25 lexical ranking over all 7,708 cases after excluding the query itself and all gold candidates for that query.
selection_protocol.isolation_note: Subagent reviewers receive pair assignments from blind_review_queue.json without gold/non-gold membership labels. Main orchestrator holds manifest.json for phase orchestration and final metric computation; therefore isolation is subagent-level blind (not double-blind at orchestrator level).
